name: PersonaXpand
author: Nextoria Information Technology LLC
description: Post and schedule to 8 social networks, answer comments and DMs in your own voice, and check analytics. Remote MCP server with OAuth sign-in; replies are shown to you before they are sent.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Read the signed-in person's profile and settings

tools.name: list_connected_accounts
tools.description: List the social accounts connected to PersonaXpand

tools.name: get_plan_usage
tools.description: Show what is left on the person's plan

tools.name: get_voice
tools.description: Read the person's writing voice, rules and length per network

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: List recent notifications

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Create a draft post for one or more networks

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Edit a draft or scheduled post

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Read one post with its per-network versions

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List posts by status and date

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a post for a time or the best time

tools.name: reschedule_post
tools.description: Move a scheduled post to a new time

tools.name: publish_post_now
tools.description: Publish a post immediately

tools.name: pause_post
tools.description: Pause a scheduled post

tools.name: resume_post
tools.description: Resume a paused post

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete a post

tools.name: list_inbox
tools.description: List new comments, DMs and mentions

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a full conversation thread

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Send a reply the person has approved

tools.name: schedule_reply
tools.description: Schedule an approved reply

tools.name: mark_handled
tools.description: Mark a message as handled

tools.name: list_reply_drafts
tools.description: List auto-reply drafts waiting for approval

tools.name: approve_reply_draft
tools.description: Approve and send a reply draft

tools.name: reject_reply_draft
tools.description: Turn down a reply draft

tools.name: get_auto_reply_settings
tools.description: Read auto-reply settings

tools.name: set_auto_reply
tools.description: Turn auto-replies on or off

tools.name: set_account_auto_reply
tools.description: Set auto-replies for one account

tools.name: create_auto_reply_rule
tools.description: Create an auto-reply rule

tools.name: update_auto_reply_rule
tools.description: Change an auto-reply rule

tools.name: delete_auto_reply_rule
tools.description: Delete an auto-reply rule

tools.name: get_analytics_summary
tools.description: Summarise how posts performed

tools.name: refresh_analytics
tools.description: Pull fresh numbers from the networks

tools.name: get_best_times
tools.description: Best times to post for each network

tools.name: list_media
tools.description: List the person's media library

tools.name: import_media_from_link
tools.description: Add a photo or video from a link

tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Create a one-time upload link

tools.name: get_upload_result
tools.description: Check the result of an upload link
